conviction_note: Two live supply lines that can sell on 09-23 sum to -4.0: a floating-price convertible preferred and an open US$50m ATM, on a company worth about US$15m. None of the 1,788,233 preferred shares had converted by 09-14, and today's low resets the conversion price lower. The name's own record is 6 comparable falls, all 6 lower by the next close (median -7.13%), and the fall came on 11.8x volume, so I shaded the sum down to -4.5 rather than toward the +0.4 cross-section prior. No repricing mechanism was found.
bar: Sized against this stock's own comparable falls in the sealed baseline: n=6, median next close -7.13%, 0% up. The 14-day ATR is 62.1% and there is no options market. cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: An 08:00 ET release said NuRAN would pilot Starlink backhaul in Nigeria, through third-party providers and with no contract with Starlink or SpaceX. The stock opened +2.96%, then sold off 16.96% intraday on 11.8x its 20-day dollar volume. That happened while a US$50m H.C. Wainwright ATM (live since 09-15) and a floating-price Series A convertible (live since the CSE delisting on 09-04) were both able to supply stock. No filing shows ATM sales or conversions today, which is why confidence is 55.

evidence.claim: 6-K dated 2026-09-22 carries the Starlink LEO backhaul pilot release as Exhibit 99.1
The release was published at 08:00 AM ET. It says NuRAN has no direct contractual relationship with Starlink or SpaceX, names no revenue and names no new customer contract
US$50,000,000 ATM with H.C. Wainwright, 3.0% commission, sales at management's sole discretion
Once the shares left the CSE, the Series A conversion price became the lower of C$4.25 and 95% of the lowest Nasdaq trade over the prior 5 trading days. Dividends accrue at 15% PIK
The voluntary CSE delisting took effect at the close on 2026-09-04

pipeline.next_dated_event: none found inside the window. The two supply lines are continuous and undated: preferred conversions are at the holder's option at any time, and ATM sales are at management's discretion. No results date, hearing or deadline was found for 2026-09-23.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A 6-K before the 09-23 open saying the preferred has been redeemed, restructured or fully converted, or that the ATM is suspended. Either would remove the undated supply that both findings rest on.

positioning_check: Short interest was 20,036 shares at the 2026-08-31 settlement, 1.0 days to cover on 46,181 average daily volume. The 08/14 row is empty, so no change can be computed. FINRA publishes about eight business days after settlement, so the position carried into today's fall cannot be seen (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/NUR/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). Against 13,194,700 shares outstanding that is negligible, so a squeeze is not a mechanism. 13G holders with event date 2026-06-30 are Menachem Wagner 9.9% (incl. 371,507 warrant shares), Frontier Nuclear & Minerals 9.9% and Starlink Capital LLC 7.6%, and all carry warrants. Nasdaq reports no insider trades in the last 12 months. There is no options market, so no skew.

findings.finding: The Series A convertible preferred can be converted on 2026-09-23 at 95% of the lowest Nasdaq trade of the prior five sessions, and that five-day window now includes today's intraday low. There are 1,788,233 shares (C$7.6m of principal plus 15% PIK), none converted as of 2026-09-14. Each conversion delivers more common shares than it could before today, into a float of 13.19m.
findings.mechanism_in_window: Conversion is at the holder's option 'at any time and from time to time', and the floating price has applied since the CSE delisting on 2026-09-04. Today's low enters the 5-day lookback for any conversion dated 09-23. Tomorrow is therefore a session where the conversion terms are the best they have been for the holders, not a later date.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The floating price went live when the CSE listing ended on 09-04. Since then this stock fell 36.99% on 09-09 (next close -9.03%) and 15.0% on 09-15 (next close -9.24%). In the baseline, all 6 comparable falls were lower by the next close. No filing ties either of those days to conversions, so this row is context and not proof.
findings.why_not_priced: The fall prices today's selling. It cannot price the extra shares the ratchet creates at the lower reset: at today's price the C$7.6m of principal converts into roughly a third or more of the current float (my arithmetic on the disclosed terms, with no FX source cited). That supply exists only once a holder converts and sells, which can happen tomorrow. If it were priced, the stock would need a buyer standing under that amount of paper, and the tape shows no such buyer: no insider buys, no 13D, no index flow.
findings.independence: The 2026-09-15 prospectus supplement independently confirms that all 1,788,233 preferred shares were outstanding as of 09-14, quotes the same floating formula, and warns of dilution from conversion and from resale under the registration rights agreement: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1680637/000175392626001773/g085942_suppl.htm

findings.finding: A US$50m H.C. Wainwright ATM is open on an effective F-10 shelf (EFFECT 2026-08-26, prospectus supplement 2026-09-15), on a company worth about US$15m. The issuer refreshed the shelf's incorporated documents on 09-18 (amended material change report) and 09-21 (amended and restated AIF), so the company can sell stock into the 09-23 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM sells at prevailing prices on any Nasdaq session at management's discretion. The registration is effective and the shelf documents were refreshed on 09-18 and 09-21, so nothing procedural stops sales on 09-23.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The ATM was announced on 09-15, when the stock fell 15.0%; the next close was -9.24% (baseline history). The stock is -46.2% over 20 sessions since the Nasdaq listing, and every comparable fall in that period continued the next day.
findings.why_not_priced: The ATM is known, but its capacity is more than three times the market value. Every rebound meets issuer supply, so the price holds today's selling and not the rest of a program that has most of its capacity left. The issuer puts out releases often (09-10 maritime, 09-22 Starlink) and today's release went out with the ATM live. If the price held the ATM fully, a release would lift the stock rather than mark a session high at the open.
findings.independence: The EDGAR submissions index shows the F-10 EFFECT on 2026-08-26, the SUPPL on 2026-09-15, and 6-Ks on 09-18 and 09-21 incorporating documents into F-10 file 333-298508: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1680637/000175392626001839/g085960_6k.htm

outside_window.finding: Nasdaq minimum bid price: spot US$1.15 is within 25% of US$1. A deficiency needs 30 consecutive business days below US$1, so no notice can land inside the window. The prospectus lists minimum bid price among continued-listing standards the company may fail.
Going-concern language appears in the amended and restated material change report filed 2026-09-18. It repeats at every periodic filing; the next interim results have no company-announced date.
The Starlink backhaul pilot in Nigeria may expand to the DRC, Cote d'Ivoire, Benin and Cameroon if it succeeds. That is undated and conditional on third-party service arrangements.

searched_and_found_nothing: Leg 1 repricing: the full release (stocktitan, 08:00 ET) says outright that there is no contract with Starlink or SpaceX and gives no revenue. An overnight reader of the document has less reason to buy than the headline gave, so there is no 'document contradicts the headline' mechanism. No analyst coverage, no Form 4 buyers (Nasdaq insider-trades: 0 in 3m/12m), no 13D, no wire error found.
The SUPPL records no prior overnight takedown or registered direct on this shelf. Only one SUPPL (the ATM) is on EDGAR (data.sec.gov submissions), so I do not assert an overnight offering.

Results or earnings date in the window: the 08-10 6-K held the registration rights agreement and the preferred terms, not financials. next_earnings_estimated is no_date_in_text, and no company-announced date was found.

baseline_tension: The findings agree with the reaction function: heavy volume (11.8x), a very high ATR (62%), and this name's own 6 comparable falls all lower the next day (median -7.13%). They disagree only with the cross-section prior of +0.4 for the -15..-10 band, which this name's documented dilution machinery gives reason to set aside. So the emitted -4.5 sits slightly beyond the -4.0 sum and well short of the own-history median.
